definitions.full: H1811. dalaph דָּלַף verb drop, drip (Wisdom Literature.) (Late Hebrew id. ( זלף more common), דֶּלֶף through , etc., Aramaic דְּלַף , , drip ) — Qal Perfect 3feminine singular עֵינִי דָּֽלְפָה אֶלאֱֿלוֺהַּ Job 16:20 i.e. weeps ( drops in tears); מִתּוּגָה נַפְשִׁי דָּֽלְפָה Psa 119:28 i.e. weeps (itself away Che compare De); Imperfect הַבָּֽיִת׃ יִדְלֹף יָדַיִם בְּשִׁפְלוּת Eccl 10:18 the house drips , i.e. leaks, because cracks are not mended.
